messages.author: 206bb0364046e85a
messages.subject: Problems fitting ecological model
parts:
Dear friends,

I am newo to lavaan and sem. I have studied Grace's Structural Equation Modeling and Natural Systems in order to get started. My N = 66. I am having troubles fitting the model below:

When trying to fit the model reproduced below, I get the following erro message:

"In lavaan(model = model, data = traits.sem, model.type = "sem", :
lavaan WARNING: model has NOT converged!"

I could not find a reference to this error message in the tutorial nor in the book. I tried to reduce my model by droping one or two expected relations, and the message changed to:

"Error in solve.default(E) :
sistem is computacionally singular: recíproca condition number = 2.18787e-26
Lost warning menssages:
1: In estimateVCOV(lavaanModel, samplestats = lavaanSampleStats, options = lavaanOptions, :
lavaan WARNING: could not compute standard errors!

2: In pchisq(chisq, df) : NaNs produzidos
3: In lavaan(model = model, data = traits.sem, model.type = "sem", :
lavaan WARNING: some estimated variances are negative
4: In lavaan(model = model, data = traits.sem, model.type = "sem", :
lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables is not positive definite;. use inspect(fit,"cov.lv") to investigate."

My model is:


library(lavaan)
model = '
# Latent variables

resource.capture =~ foliar + sla
resource.conservation =~ sla + dens
growth =~ cres.adult + cresc.adult.perc95
shape =~ alometria + pcopa

# Regressions between latent variables

resource.capture ~ resource.conservation
growth ~ resource.capture + resource.conservation
shape ~ growth + hmax.peld
mort.adult =~ growth + resource.capture + resource.conservation
hmax.peld =~ growth + mort.adult
#semente =~ growth + mort.adult
#ln.simetria =~ growth + mort.adult

# Residual correlations

foliar ~~ sla + dens
sla ~~ dens
cres.adult ~~ cresc.adult.perc95
'

fit = sem(model, data = traits.sem)

Do someone knows the meaning of these messages and why are they appearing? What should I do?

Thank you in advance for any help,

Alexandre

Dr. Alexandre F. Souza
Professor Adjunto II Departamento de Botanica, Ecologia e Zoologia Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Norte (UFRN) http://www.docente.ufrn.br/alexsouza Curriculo: lattes.cnpq.br/7844758818522706
